title: Console dashboards & rollout pages — accessibility and i18n readiness review
creator: Priya Nair
description: Audit and redesign key Console surfaces (Dashboards, Rollouts, Cost views) for WCAG 2.1 AA conformance and production localization readiness. Deliver a prototype and a prioritized implementation plan for engineering. Key areas: keyboard navigation and focus management for complex widgets, color token contrast adjustments for metrics/charts, semantic table and pagination accessibility, ARIA annotations for rollout controls, and string extraction/ICU adoption for i18n. Scope excludes backend translation pipelines and billing system currency conversions — we will hand off format requirements to Eng/PM after design signoff.
acceptance_criteria: All interactive controls on dashboard, rollout and cost pages are reachable and operable via keyboard with a clear focus indicator
Text contrast meets WCAG AA: >=4.5:1 for body text, >=3:1 for large text; metric badges and sparkline annotations brought into compliance
Screen reader announcements exist for rollouts state changes (canary start/stop, fallback) using live regions
Table rows and pagination expose semantic roles and keyboard-friendly row selection for details view
Prototype demonstrates localized layouts for English, German, and Japanese including string overflows and number/currency formatting
Design tokens updated with accessible color aliases and documented token usage for charts and badges
Figma prototype approved by PM and Eng reviewers and linked in ticket
Design handoff includes component-level ARIA guidance, i18n string context notes, and example ICU message patterns
comments: 2025-02-10 - Priya Nair: Kickoff audit completed. Ran axe/pa11y on dashboard routes; initial high-priority failures: low-contrast badges (2.8:1), missing focus indicators on chart toolbar, and unlabeled icon buttons in rollout detail pane.

2025-02-11 - Marisol Chen: Drafted component-level patterns: accessible table row focus state, aria-sort for cost table, and keyboard shortcuts for rollout actions. Added preliminary color token palette with contrast-tested variants.

2025-02-12 - Eng feedback (Diego Alvarez): Concern about chart color palette changes affecting brand. Suggested introducing accessible variants that map to existing brand colors via light/dark contrast overlays to avoid major visual regression.

2025-02-14 - Priya Nair: Updated Figma prototype (link below). Implemented live region pattern for rollout status; added example aria-live polite message flow for canary progress. Noted potential perf impact of aria-live updates for high-frequency metrics — flagged for Eng investigation.

2025-02-16 - PM review (Aisha Mohammed): Prioritized keyboard nav and labels for initial sprint. Moved color token rollout to secondary sprint after we confirm chart library support for token overrides.

2025-02-18 - Marisol Chen: Design review with Accessibility SMEs scheduled for 2025-02-20. Preparing detailed acceptance test checklist and handoff doc for Eng. Started extraction of strings to i18n key list; ~120 keys identified across dashboards/rollouts/cost views.
